system.description:
Spend an Attack or Interact Action to insult an enemy: it must pass a CR 2 Heart Check or take 3 Soul damage.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.53
system.summary: Spend an Attack or Interact Action to insult an enemy: it must pass a CR 2 Heart Check or take 3 Soul damage.

automation.note: The target enemy rolls a CR 2 Heart Check; if it fails, it takes 3 Soul damage (Soul ignores armour). You may spend an Interact Action instead of an Attack Action.
